findings.highlight: you've risen so far up the ranks
findings.evidenceJa: 飯塚君が担当になってからかなり上がってるのよ。ここの売り場の成績
findings.explanation: The sales performance of this store has risen considerably since Iizuka took charge. Todokanai TL instead says Iizuka himself rose through the corporate ranks, changing both subject and business context immediately before the celebration proposal.
findings.japanese:
「飯塚君が担当になってからかなり上がってるのよ。
ここの売り場の成績」
findings.todokanai: "Iizuka-kun, ever since they put you in charge, you've risen so far up the ranks."

findings.evidenceJa: 短大出や高卒のコもよりどりみどり
findings.explanation: The prospective mixer includes a choice of junior-college graduates and high-school graduates. Todokanai TL turns 短大出 into underclassmen, replacing an educational background with a relative school-year status.
findings.japanese:
「今年入ったコたち、結構可愛いよ？
短大出や高卒のコもよりどりみどり」
findings.todokanai: "The girls in this one are quite cute, you know? You can pick and choose from underclassmen to high school graduates!"

findings.highlight: we've gathered around five or six people
findings.evidenceJa: だからさ、そっちも５、６人揃えてさ
findings.explanation: The woman asks Iizuka to assemble five or six men on his side, even if they are friends rather than coworkers. Todokanai TL says her side has already gathered the group, reversing the request that makes his Houjou connections relevant.
findings.japanese:
「だからさ、そっちも５、６人揃えてさ…
会社絡みじゃなくて友達関係でもいいから」
findings.todokanai: "So we've gathered around five or six people. You can just see the whole thing as a friendly outing, rather than a corporate thing."

findings.highlight: Especially not when the welcoming ceremony is already finished…
findings.evidenceJa: こっちはもう三か月も前から準備してるんですよ？
findings.explanation: Mizusawa finishes by protesting that her group has been preparing the retail-training program for three months. Todokanai TL drops that entire investment and leaves the quotation open, weakening the concrete basis of her anger.
findings.japanese:
「新人教育から販売店研修を削るなんて！
それも入社式が終わってからそんなこと…
こっちはもう三か月も前から準備してるんですよ？」
findings.todokanai: "You can't just remove the sales course from the employee training! Especially not when the welcoming ceremony is already finished…

findings.highlight: The other departments are demanding I send them more manpower ASAP.
findings.evidenceJa: 君らの努力が無駄になったことは済まなく思っているが
findings.explanation: The manager acknowledges and apologizes that the group's effort has been wasted before Mizusawa dismisses that as mere venting. Todokanai TL omits the apology, leaves the quotation unfinished, and removes the premise of her reply.
findings.japanese:
「いや、今期は全社的に負荷が高くて、
新人を早くよこせという他部署の意見が強くてね。
君らの努力が無駄になったことは済まなく思っているが」
findings.todokanai: "Like I said, the company is short on staff this season. The other departments are demanding I send them more manpower ASAP.

findings.evidenceJa: リーダー含め、全員の意見をまとめて持って来てます
findings.explanation: Mizusawa has brought the unified opinion of everyone in her particular group, including its leader. Todokanai TL expands this into all employees and plural managers, materially inflating the constituency she claims to represent.
findings.japanese:
「もちろんです。
リーダー含め、全員の意見をまとめて持って来てます」
findings.todokanai: "Of course. I've gathered the opinions of all employees, including the managers."

findings.highlight: convey some rawness in your reporting
findings.evidenceJa: 雑誌ってのは人が作ってんだ。もっとこう、血の通ったコミュニケーションってもんが
findings.explanation: Hamada argues that magazines are made by people and therefore require warm, human communication. Todokanai TL changes that interpersonal principle into conveying rawness in reporting, shifting the object from working relationships to prose style.
findings.japanese:
「しかしだな、それじゃあまりにもビジネスライクだろ。
雑誌ってのは人が作ってんだ。
もっとこう、血の通ったコミュニケーションってもんが」
findings.todokanai: "But it becomes too businesslike otherwise. Magazines are written by people, so you need to convey some rawness in your reporting."

findings.highlight: going out of one's way is good
findings.evidenceJa: 浜田さんが前から言ってる『必要な無駄』って奴でしょ
findings.explanation: Matsuoka names Hamada's established principle of 'necessary waste': apparently inefficient human contact that still has value. Todokanai TL paraphrases it as going out of one's way being good, deleting the quoted oxymoron and its callback function.
findings.japanese:
「浜田さんが前から言ってる『必要な無駄』って奴でしょ。
そりゃ、俺だってそういうの嫌いじゃないですよ。
けど今は、優先順位ってもんがあるんですよ」
findings.todokanai: "I know, you're telling me that going out of one's way is good. I don't disagree with that. But right now I have other priorities that take precedence."

findings.evidenceJa: 先輩にノロケ話聞かせておいて
findings.explanation: The senior jokes that Setsuna has made her senior listen to romantic bragging and is now refusing weekend work as an advanced tactic. Todokanai TL calls the listener Setsuna's junior, reversing their workplace relationship.
findings.japanese:
「つまりあれよね～。
先輩にノロケ話聞かせておいて、
ついでに休日出勤も断るという高等戦術」
findings.todokanai: "In other words, on top of always forcing your junior to listen to you ramble on about your boyfriend, you're also going to refuse working on the weekends."

findings.highlight: Two springs ago I graduated university
findings.evidenceJa: 大学を卒業して、二度目の四月。社会に出て、二年目の春
findings.explanation: This is the second April since graduation and Setsuna's second spring in working life. Todokanai TL says she graduated two springs ago, moving the graduation itself back an extra year and blurring the carefully parallel calendar markers.
findings.japanese:
わたしにとっては、
大学を卒業して、二度目の四月。
社会に出て、二年目の春。
findings.todokanai: Two springs ago I graduated university, and for two springs I have worked for my current company.

findings.highlight: A friend who never broke the oath that we swore last spring.
findings.evidenceJa: かつて自分が持っていた輝きを、やっと取り戻した友
findings.explanation: The spring inventory contains three friends: one aflame with hope in a new place, one keeping last spring's vow, and one who has finally regained her former radiance. Todokanai TL omits the third friend and breaks the route-wide portrait of everyone advancing separately.
findings.japanese:
新しい自分の居場所で、希望に燃える友。
去年の春に建てた誓いをずっと守り続けてる友。
かつて自分が持っていた輝きを、やっと取り戻した友。
findings.todokanai: A friend burning with hope, in a new place to belong. A friend who never broke the oath that we swore last spring.

findings.highlight: I screamed at my own failure, so much worse than anything I did five years ago.
findings.evidenceJa: そして、五年前よりも強い気持ちを思い出し
findings.explanation: Setsuna weeps with the same regret as five years ago, screams at a more complete defeat, and then remembers feelings stronger than five years ago. Todokanai TL omits the third movement—the renewed strength that explains her return to Haruki's room.
findings.japanese:
五年前と同じ後悔に泣き。
五年前よりも完全な敗北に叫び。
そして、五年前よりも強い気持ちを思い出し。
findings.todokanai: I weeped with the same regret as five years ago. I screamed at my own failure, so much worse than anything I did five years ago.

findings.evidenceJa: 『過分な仕事を任されたことによるプレッシャー』に原因の一端があると認定し、休職扱いにしてくれた
findings.explanation: The occupational physician attributes part of Haruki's condition to pressure from being entrusted with excessive work, and the company consequently places him on leave. Todokanai TL invents 'unjust overwork' and stops before the crucial employment outcome.
findings.japanese:
産業医との面談で、
『過分な仕事を任されたことによるプレッシャー』
に原因の一端があると認定し、休職扱いにしてくれた。
findings.todokanai: After an interview with an occupational health physician, they determined that his condition was partly due to "stress from unjust overwork"

findings.highlight: Because he never got any decent sleep since his graduation from university.
findings.evidenceJa: あの頃足りてなかった睡眠時間をやっと取り戻してると思えば全然問題ない
findings.explanation: Setsuna rationalizes his hypersomnia as finally recovering the sleep he lacked during university, and therefore no problem at all. Todokanai TL omits that conclusion and shifts the deprivation to the period after graduation.
findings.japanese:
だって、大学の時から全然眠っていなかったんだから。
あの頃足りてなかった睡眠時間を
やっと取り戻してると思えば全然問題ない。
findings.todokanai: Because he never got any decent sleep since his graduation from university.

findings.highlight: I can finally admit this, now that I feel so fulfilled.
findings.evidenceJa: 自分が満たされてからやっと、こんなこと言い出してる
findings.explanation: Haruki condemns himself for only starting to tell Setsuna to leave after she has washed, cooked, embraced him, and filled his needs. Todokanai TL makes it sound like fulfillment has finally enabled an honest admission, softening the selfish timing he is indicting.
findings.japanese:
「洗濯してもらって、料理してもらって、
抱きしめてもらって…
自分が満たされてからやっと、こんなこと言い出してる」
findings.todokanai: "You did my laundry, you cooked for me, you embraced me… I can finally admit this, now that I feel so fulfilled."

findings.highlight: Not so I can save him, but to satisfy my own desires.
findings.evidenceJa: 彼を救いたいから、だけじゃない。自分の欲望も満足させたかったから
findings.explanation: Setsuna says saving Haruki was not her only motive; she also wanted to satisfy her own desire. Todokanai TL turns the additive confession into an exclusive contrast—she did not act to save him, only for herself—making her self-accusation much harsher than the source.
findings.japanese:
彼を救いたいから、だけじゃない。
自分の欲望も満足させたかったから。
findings.todokanai: Not so I can save him, but to satisfy my own desires.

findings.highlight: All I want to do… is to convince myself that the past two years weren't for nothing
findings.evidenceJa: ただ不戦勝で残っただけの、わたしの二年間を、誰にも否定されたくなかったから
findings.explanation: Setsuna does not want anyone else to deny the two years that remained to her only by a walkover. Todokanai TL says she is trying to convince herself they were not meaningless, replacing possessive defiance toward outsiders with private uncertainty.
findings.japanese:
ただ不戦勝で残っただけの、わたしの二年間を、
誰にも否定されたくなかったから。
findings.todokanai: All I want to do… is to convince myself that the past two years weren't for nothing… when I won only because my opponent withdrew.
